records.evidence: Eight ordered whole drawings show staggered forecontacts 0/1, gathered recovery 2/3, alternating hind contacts 4/5, hind push 6, extended recovery 7. Forepaws in 4–6 correctly airborne after targeted repair. Four anatomical limb identities remain readable; torso registration stable.

Eight ordered drawings separate forecontacts, gather/recover, hindcontacts with airborne front wrists, then extend. Fixed canvas source pose2 repaired low hind toe; latest runtime frame no below-ground hind toe. Head/torso stable except deliberate small bounce.
records.style: Low-poly sculpted volumes and painted stripes wrap anatomy; no photoreal fur or flat cut-paper third style.

records.evidence: Forecontact roles alternate; front paws folded/suspended during rear support in 4–6. Near/far hind identity visible across cycle despite natural occlusion in one rear contact pose. Compact gathering and reach differ from cheetah extension; stable original world registration.
records.style: Soft sculpted 3D consistent with original rainforest animals.

records.evidence: Near-front lead in 0 versus far-front lead in 4; corresponding diagonal rear limbs change. Gather/pass drawings and short flight have all four connected limbs. No fixed rear struts; fixed original canvas registration.

Selected four new whole drawings: 0 near-hind recovery, 1 near-fore recovery, 2 far-hind recovery, 3 far-fore recovery. Other three limbs support; whole hoof clearance visible in all recovery poses. Near-fore identity repair prevents duplicate far-fore recovery. Latest same-zoom actual runtime contact sheet checked; stable head/shoulder/torso full camera.
records.rejected: Old eight-pose atlas and proposed reorder rejected because no readable hind recovery.

records.evidence: Four whole drawings show near-hind, near-fore, far-hind, far-fore independent recovery. Same-zoom actual runtime and original source camera inspected. Pose4 head/upper torso rise is weight transfer with common planted soles and comparable horizontal torso/face proportions, not whole-bounding-box scale normalization. Small authored drawing variation accepted.

Actual ordered runtime drawings show near/far fore recovery distinguished by shoulder depth and limb width, and both hind limbs raised in different phases (rear outer in 2/5, inner in 3/6). Torso/head stable. Accept as brisk walk rhythm rather than claiming mechanically exact diagonal trot.

Actual ordered runtime: both foreleg recovery roles switch; rear outer visibly lifts in 2/6 and inner lifts in 3/7. Bright near and dark far feet change airborne/stance roles. No whole-body flight or fixed hindlegs; body/head stable.

Final replacement four whole drawings and same-zoom actual runtime inspected: bright near-fore recovery, dark far-hind recovery, dark far-fore recovery, bright near-hind recovery. Each has other three paws supporting. Complete four-leg root anatomy and correct near/far phase identities, stable head/torso framing, slight deliberate weight transfer. Configuration correctly labels walk.
records.rejected: Old eight-pose atlas had foreleg swapping but frozen hind supports; fully withdrawn, not counted as final acceptance.

records.evidence: Final four whole drawings and same-zoom actual runtime checked: 0 bright outer near-hind recovery, 1 broad bright near-fore recovery, 2 dark inner far-hind recovery, 3 dark inner far-fore recovery. Three supporting soles and one full hoof-height recovery clearance in each key. Head, stripes, shoulder and torso full-camera registration stable. Explicit walk configuration; not labelled diagonal trot.
records.rejected: Old eight-pose atlas withdrawn for missing far-hind recovery. New initial pose0 duplicate far-hind role withdrawn and repaired to near-hind; final source no fixed hindleg.

records.evidence: Final same-zoom runtime cycle inspected after replacement raw4 dark far-hind recovery. Both forelegs and bright near-hind retain distinct recovery in other original drawings. New far-hind raised under abdomen with three supporting feet, no whole-body flight. Exact whole-view camera and torso are compatible with other seven originals; no bbox or forced ground alignment.
records.rejected: Original raw4 and atlas sequence lacked clear far-hind recovery; replacement whole drawing supplies missing phase instead of hiding defect by reordering.

visualReviews.method: Near/far fore/hind each must visibly lift, recover forwards and return to stance over the cycle; four visible feet in one drawing alone is insufficient. Frames may naturally occlude one far foot. Exact authored body pixels are not required, but no bbox-normalized scale/ground fixes. Limited rhythmic key drawings accepted; no procedural rig final images.
Complete independently painted originals; no runtime joint mesh, no frame blends. Private legacy sketches only art references.
